about: The asks graview.dev shows, as they were answered: each the words a person typed, the app they typed them in, and the worker view that came back — its manifest here, its script beside this file. The page replays these; nothing calls a model when the site is built or read. tests/site-asks.test.ts runs each view headless against its app, as the host would, and holds what it draws to what the page says it draws.

turns.name: departures
turns.ask: Make the modules page look like an airport departures board.
turns.answer: Drew the modules as a split-flap departures board: gate, crew and status off the graph, the docs written today in WRITTEN.

turns.name: remaining-games
turns.ask: Give me a list view of remaining games and who's bringing snacks
turns.answer: Drew the games still to play, soonest first, each with the family bringing snacks, and Sign up on the one nobody has taken.

turns.name: courier
turns.ask: Make this app look more like a physical newspaper
turns.answer: Drew the front page as a weekly paper: the next game as the lead story, the results, the snack duty, and a WANTED ad for each game nobody brings snacks to.
